Structural_break_diagnostics.sample: Processed decision-date panel only; raw monthly lending files are present but are not used in this diagnostic.
Structural_break_diagnostics.frequency_limitation: Growth is percent change between adjacent NBK decision observations, not monthly or annual growth. This diagnostic does not use the raw monthly lending files to estimate monthly-series breaks.
Structural_break_diagnostics.multiple_testing_limitation: Unknown-break bootstrap p-values account for scanning candidate dates within each series/form, but are not adjusted across features and transformations.
Structural_break_diagnostics.stationarity: ADF/KPSS were not applied to the monthly source series in this diagnostic. The analyzed processed panel is irregularly spaced at NBK decision dates; standard regular-frequency interpretations would be misleading, and break tests do not establish stationarity.
Structural_break_diagnostics.unit_evidence: Supplied raw CSVs are available, but publisher provenance and measurement units are not authenticated; header-based unit hints remain unverified.
